items.title: File Widerspruch against the Bescheid denying the Brauchtumsfeuer permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: Letter is dated and apparently posted 2026-11-18 (Wednesday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is given, so the printed letter date is taken as the posting day. The letter itself states the delivery fiction: 'Ein Bescheid, den die Behörde mit einfachem Brief verschickt, gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben (§ 110 Abs. 2 LVwG).' Counting the posting day (18.11.) as day 0: day 1 = 19.11., day 2 = 20.11., day 3 = 21.11., day 4 = 22.11.2026 (a Sunday). This Amt (Ordnungsamt, a general administrative authority, not a tax office) is governed by § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG / the equivalent of § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG: unlike tax offices, the deemed-delivery day does NOT move even if it falls on a Sunday. So Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery) = Sunday, 2026-11-22. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs from the day after delivery (§ 31 Abs. 1 LVwG / §§ 187, 188 BGB) and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 22.12.2026. Checking the weekday of 22.12.2026 (a Tuesday, no public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein) — the final day of a period rule (moving to the next working day if the last day is a Saturday, Sunday or holiday) does not need to apply here since 22.12.2026 is already a normal working day. Final deadline: 2026-12-22.
